explanation: Do not cache get_user results for the lifetime of a process. A cached user could retain old roles after access is revoked. #640 is the related issue.
Check db.Query's error before scheduling rows.Close(). On error, rows is nil, so trying to close it would fail. The instruction applies to the query and the following defer.

Use setTimeout with a zero delay for measure(el) so layout can settle before measurement. A queueMicrotask callback would run too soon. measure is the measurement function; el is the element being measured.
Never log the contents of the Secret<String> token. Its Debug output must remain redacted so debugging cannot expose the secret. Secret<String> is the token's type.

Keep the RetryCount constant in sync with the Http.Retry setting in appsettings.json; change both together. appsettings.json is the configuration file, and Http.Retry identifies the setting within it.
Before mapping with ch.map, ensure offset is divisible by pageSize. The memory mapping operation rejects offsets that are not page aligned. offset and pageSize are the values in that requirement.
Keep the trailing slash on the rsync source build/. It makes rsync copy the directory's contents into DEST rather than copying the build directory itself. DEST is the destination variable.

The BRIN index on events.created_at is chosen because its stated size is about 1% of a btree index and events are appended in time order. created_at is the indexed column; btree is the index type used for the size comparison.

Replace this loop, which repeatedly checks flag while waiting, with a futex wait. The stated completion condition is that lock_acquire in src/sync/lock.c sleeps while waiting. src/sync/lock.c is the file path, and lock_acquire is the function.

The reason dbo.RebuildStats runs on the secondary is documented in the failover section of the runbook. doc:runbook#failover points to that document and section; dbo.RebuildStats is the procedure this comment describes.
Keep this timeout below 60 seconds so it expires before the upstream proxy kills a request that has been idle for 60 seconds. The configured value here is 30 seconds.
Keep Widget's destructor virtual. If it becomes non-virtual, deleting a derived object through a Widget pointer can skip the derived destructor. #915 is the related issue.
Run PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON before any writes on each database connection. The setting applies per connection, so enabling it on one connection does not enable it on another.

Use the fixed-size ShortString form string[40] for Name because the containing record is written directly to disk byte for byte. Changing it to string would change the record's stored representation. Name is the record field.

Bind the caller-supplied p_id value when executing this DELETE. Concatenating it into an EXECUTE IMMEDIATE SQL string could allow SQL injection. :1 is the bind placeholder, and USING p_id supplies its value.
